name: Meme Battlegrounds
desc:
A Battlegrounds with Chinese meme elements.

📱💻 You can play on any device. (PC, MOBILE)
⭐ Like and Favourite the game for more Update.

🖥️ Controls
G - Ultimate mode
F - Block
Q - Dash
Q (while ragdolled) - Ragdoll cancel/evasive
Double Tap W - Run
Left Click - Punch

Inspired The Strongest Battlegrounds.
